title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 525  An Act Converting the Abuyon Barangay High School in the Municipality of San Narciso, Province of Quezon, Into a National High School to Be Known as the Abuyon National High School and Appropriating Funds therefor.

title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Abuyon Barangay tại Thị trấn San Narciso, Tỉnh Quezon thành Trường Trung học Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Abuyon Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Abuyon Barangay ในเทศบาล San Narciso จังหวัด Quezon เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Abuyon แห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sekolah Menengah Abuyon Barangay di Kotamadya San Narciso, Provinsi Quezon menjadi Sekolah Menengah Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Abuyon Nasional

text.en:
The Abuyon Barangay High School in the Municipality of San Narciso, Province of Quezon, is
converted into a national high school to be known as the Abuyon National High School.

The operation of said school for the current fiscal year shall continue to be funded out of local
funds and from its share of national aid to local schools. The requirements for succeeding fiscal years shall be
provided in the forthcoming General Appropriations Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 10, 1983
